title: Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2611.18648v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens' teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher--reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. translated_title: 重新思考离线在策略蒸馏：从标量优势到分布式监督
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生生成的轨迹上提供token级别的反馈来转移教师模型的能力，但反复用教师模型评估新生成的rollout在计算上代价高昂。诸如Lightning OPD之类的离线方法通过在固定的参考rollout上缓存所记录token的教师对数概率来降低这一成本。通过将这一想法扩展到多轮智能体搜索设置中，我们发现其表现持续低于由同一教师模型训练的SFT起点。我们在实证上观察到比数学推理场景中更严重的教师-参考失配以及训练后分布变平现象，并从理论上证明：在适当条件下，固定rollout上的标量优势监督会产生输出分布变平的解。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了分布式在策略蒸馏（DistOPD），这是一种简单而有效的离线OPD方法，它保留了候选（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现基于固定rollout的离线在策略蒸馏因标量优势监督会导致输出分布变平，并提出用分布式监督替代标量优势的DistOPD方法来解决这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that offline on-policy distillation with scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts causes output distribution flattening, and proposes DistOPD, which replaces scalar advantages with distributional supervision.
